title: OnsiteGene 2 Protocol for Direct Saliva Collection
author: yliu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bpjgmkjw
materials: Ensure all collection materials are labelled with the correct identifying information.

steps.title: Prepare for Collection
steps.instruction: Prepare the environment and the donor for saliva collection.

substeps.instruction: Clean hands using alcohol-based sanitizer or soap and water (no fragrances).
Wear appropriate PPE (at minimum, gloves and a mask).
Maintain maximum distance from the sample donor during the process.
Direct the sample donor to begin pooling saliva in their mouth (ensure no coughing or sniffing; water avoided 10 mins prior; other drinks, food, and nasal sprays avoided 30 mins prior).

steps.title: Collect Saliva Sample
steps.instruction: Collect the saliva sample using the provided swab and storage tube.

substeps.instruction: Remove the lid of the collection tube containing 450 µL sample storage solution.
Remove the saliva swab from the package and have the donor soak the swab pad in the mouth with saliva for 15 seconds.
Place the soaked swab into the storage solution in the tube.
Remove the stick through the opening, leaving the swab pad in the tube.
Discard the stick and secure the lid.

steps.title: Secure and Register Sample
steps.instruction: Sterilize the sample container and document the collection.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize the tube surface with 70% ethanol or a disinfecting wipe.
Place the sample in a secondary container or an appropriately labeled biohazard bag.
Dispose of gloves.
Register sample collection information, including date and time.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Processing
steps.instruction: Mix and concentrate the sample before RNA release.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample at room temperature (stable for 3-5 days).
Vortex the collection tube for 5 seconds at 3000-5000 RPM (alternatively, tap or shake to mix).
Spin down the tube for 15 seconds using a centrifuge.

steps.title: Release Viral RNA
steps.instruction: Extract the RNA from the saliva sample.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of supernatant from the sample storage solution to a tube containing 20 µL SA TM direct RNA release buffer.
Secure the lid of the tube.
Heat the tube for 1 minute at 95°C on a heating block.

steps.title: Prepare RT-qPCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the reaction mixture in the qPCR tubes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 7.5 µL of viral RNA sample solution (can be stored at -20°C for 14 days) and 7.5 µL OnsiteGene Hi-Sense TM COVID-19 detection kit reaction mix (with primers and probes) into a superfast RT-qPCR reaction tube.
Secure the lid of the tube.
Spin down the tube for 15 seconds using a centrifuge or spinner.

steps.title: Run RT-qPCR Instrument
steps.instruction: Load the samples into the OnsiteGene XDive Superfast Real-Time PCT instrument and run the following thermal cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: Step 1: 50°C for 30 sec
Step 2: 95°C for 0 sec
Step 3: 60°C for 2 sec
Step 4: Read Fluorescence intensity and overhead (10 sec)
Step 5: Repeat steps 2-4 for 40 cycles

steps.title: Interpret Results
steps.instruction: Report results based on the following CT value criteria:

substeps.instruction: Negative: IC CT ≤ 40 AND SARS-Cov-2 Target (ORF1ab and N1) CT > 40.
Positive: IC CT any value AND any SARS-Cov-2 target CT ≤ 40.
Invalid: IC CT > 35 AND SARS-Cov-2 Target (ORF1ab and N1) CT > 40 (indicates IC failure or insufficient specimen volume; retest required).
Suggestive: One SARS-Cov-2 target positive (CT ≤ 40) and one SARS-Cov-2 target negative (CT > 40).
